meta.name: istio-traffic-management
meta.description: Configure Istio traffic management including routing, load balancing, circuit breakers, and canary deployments. Use when implementing service mesh traffic policies, progressive delivery, or resilience patterns.

copy.tagline: 配置服务网格流量路由与渐进式发布策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在用服务网格管理服务间流量,需要安全地滚动发布。
copy.tagline_en: Configure service mesh traffic policies for routing and progressive rollouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage service mesh traffic and need safe progressive delivery.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，当需要配置 Istio 服务网格的流量管理时，Claude 会依据模板生成对应的资源配置，覆盖路由、负载均衡、熔断、金丝雀部署、重试超时、流量镜像、故障注入、网关等。
howto.when: 当你说要做金丝雀或蓝绿部署、配置熔断或设置服务路由等流量管理需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个金丝雀发布，把10%流量转到新版本。
say.note: 会生成带权重的路由规则。

say.text: 给服务配置熔断，限制最大连接数并剔除故障实例。
say.note: 会生成连接池和异常检测配置。

say.text: 对这个接口设置重试和超时，失败时重试三次。
say.note: 会添加 retries 和 timeout 设置。

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you want to configure Istio service mesh traffic management, Claude generates resource configurations from the provided templates, covering routing, load balancing, circuit breakers, canary deployments, retries and timeouts, traffic mirroring, fault injection, and gateways.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for canary or blue-green deployments, circuit-breaking configuration, or service routing, among other traffic management needs.

say_en.text: Can you set up a canary deployment routing 10% of traffic to the new version?
say_en.note: It will generate a weighted routing rule.

say_en.text: Configure a circuit breaker with connection limits and outlier detection.
say_en.note: Adds connection pool and outlier detection settings.

say_en.text: Add retry and timeout config to this API, retrying up to 3 times on failure.
say_en.note: Adds a retries and timeout block to the VirtualService.
